page.overview:
What is Lost Kingdom of Thronus?

The Lost Kingdom of Thronus is a location in Dissidia Final Fantasy Opera Omnia. This is the third region of the game and can be explored in the third chapter of the story mode.

This region is contains a beach and a forest, while also having the ruins of civilization atop a higher location with in the center a castle that represents the kingdom.

The Lost Kingdom of Thronus is located to the west of Primus Island on a continent together with the Snowy Peaks of Crudelis and to the south of the continent the Imber Manor is located.

There are sixth locked gateways located on Lost Kingdom of Thronus.
